the histogram total is within 0.25 % of the exact grid sum at every sampled epoch
the grid total is monotone decreasing in the epoch
one 5 Gyr step and 500 × 10 Myr steps land on the same masses
after the burn the arm crests hold less gas than the troughs
the turbulence slot is deterministic in the draw seed
the step writes a smoothed star-formation rate into the display slot
at First light the gas covers the frame where the disc is
at T = 0 the median gas pixel is ~0.06 linear, p90 ~1 (the whole picture)
at AGE_REF the median gas pixel is a faint haze, ~0.008
the present-day haze is a small fraction of the First-light picture
a draw allocates the two ping-pong grid buffers at the model size
the draw uploads the grid once, into buffer A
the grid step and the grid draw are separate pipelines
the draw pass is additive into the HDR intermediate
a frozen clock dispatches no gas step
the grid is drawn as one instanced quad pass over every cell
an epoch step dispatches the burn once, ceil(cells / 64) workgroups
the step reads buffer A and writes B on the first step
the frame still draws the grid after the step
the second step swaps the ping-pong pair
the draw after a step reads the buffer the step wrote
the step uniform carries the epoch delta as dt
the step uniform carries the calibrated burn and the arm law
the grid uniform carries the cell count and the look gain
a rewound clock re-fills the grid instead of stepping it backwards
the account reports the grid total, the census gas and their drift
the grid and the census are both exactly all-gas at T = 0
hiding the grid draws no gas pass
showing it again restores the pass
the grid info reports cells, steps, age and the calibrated burn
dispose destroys both grid buffers
a renderer without the gas model still boots and draws no grid
the disabled grid reports itself disabled
